page_title: RSO 1-2 RAY | Real Sociedad v Rayo Vallecano 18/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+8' 1 - 2 Goal! Brais Mendez manages to prod the ball to Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:2.
90+7' Real Sociedad can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

90+6' Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Alejandro Hernandez with no other option than to blow for a foul. Rayo Vallecano earn a free kick.
90+4' Alejandro Hernandez shows a yellow card to Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
90+1' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Real Sociedad comes to nothing.
84' 0 - 2 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) unleashes a shot straight into the bottom right corner. Good team effort!
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) will replace Mikel Oyarzabal.
80' Inigo Perez decides to make a substitution. Andrei Ratiu will be replaced by Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano).

77' Nice move, nice attempt! Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post.
75' That will be all from Jorge de Frutos who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano).
75' Substitution. Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Adrian Embarba.
75' Imanol Alguacil has decided to make a change. Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) replaces Hamari Traore.
75' What a great touch by Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
74' The free kick is delivered by Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
74' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Real Sociedad are awarded the free kick.
73' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
73' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Real Sociedad.
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) is coming onto the pitch as Takefusa Kubo cannot continue after picking up an injury.
68' Here is a change. Benat Turrientes is going off and Imanol Alguacil gives the last tactical orders to Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad).
67' 0 - 1 Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) collects a sweet pass and scores with aplomb. His shot glanced off the crossbar and into the roof of the net. Fabulous goal!
65' What a wasted opportunity by Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano)! He unleashed a powerful low shot from the centre of the box, but Alex Remiro makes a decent save to thwart him.
63' Substitution. Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) in, Randy Nteka out.
63' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) but poses no threat.

61' Javi Lopez (Real Sociedad) latches on to the corner kick on the edge of the box and releases a quick strike. The result differs significantly from his intention as the ball flies way wide of the right post.
61' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
57' The foul by Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Alejandro Hernandez.
56' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
56' The corner is swung in but Rayo Vallecano can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
54' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
53' Alejandro Hernandez shows a yellow card to Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) for a tough tackle.
50' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) is able to continue to play.
50' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
49' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
49' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
48' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
46' Substitution. Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) did his best and is replaced by Gerard Gumbau.
46' Imanol Alguacil makes a switch. Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) is coming on in place of Urko Gonzalez at the start of the second period.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.

43' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Alejandro Hernandez blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
41' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
41' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

41' The game is interrupted. Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Free kick. Real Sociedad will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
37' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post.
33' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
32' A yellow card for a tackle by Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano). Alejandro Hernandez doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
30' The corner is swung in and Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad) leaps above the defence only to send his header a whisker wide of the right post from close in.
30' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
27' Alejandro Hernandez shows the yellow card to Urko Gonzalez (Real Sociedad) for a heavy challenge.
27' Real Sociedad failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

27' Real Sociedad have a corner. Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
25' A fine pass finds Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Dani Cardenas reacts superbly to deny him.
23' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle. Rayo Vallecano win a free kick.
20' Real Sociedad have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

18' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the roof of the net, but Dani Cardenas thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
14' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) commits a rough challenge and Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for a foul. Real Sociedad are given an advantage. They have a free kick.

12' What a chance that is! Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes well wide of the right post!
10' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
9' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. A free kick is awarded to Real Sociedad.
5' Alejandro Hernandez couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) and blew his whistle. Real Sociedad get a free kick.
3' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Rayo Vallecano.
2' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) works the corner short.

1' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) gathers a nice lofted pass deep inside the box and attempts to put the ball low inside the right post, but his shot is deflected away by one of the defending players. The linesman makes the right call and Rayo Vallecano will have a corner.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Rayo Vallecano will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Alejandro Hernandez.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
